info.description: HTTP contract for version 3 of the sws2apps API.

get.description: Returns the enabled flags for an application installation. User and congregation scoping is resolved from the installation's persisted binding; anonymous installations receive application-scoped flags only.

200.description: A map of feature names to their enabled state.

bearerAuth.description: Identity token supplied through the Authorization header.

visitorCookie.name: visitorid
visitorCookie.description: Signed, HTTP-only session cookie set after authentication.

AdministrationCongregationIdPath.name: id
AdministrationCongregationIdPath.description: Congregation identifier selected by a global administrator.

AdministrationUserIdPath.name: id
AdministrationUserIdPath.description: User account identifier selected by a global administrator.

CongregationJoinRequestUserHeader.name: user
CongregationJoinRequestUserHeader.description: Account identifier associated with the join request.

CongregationMemberEmailQuery.name: email
CongregationMemberEmailQuery.description: Account email used by the eligibility search.

AppVersionHeader.name: appversion
AppVersionHeader.description: Numeric dotted version of the calling client.

ApplicationLanguageHeader.name: applanguage
ApplicationLanguageHeader.description: Language used for localized application emails.

BackupMetadataHeader.name: metadata
BackupMetadataHeader.description: A serialized JSON object mapping dataset names to their latest client timestamps.

OriginHeader.name: Origin
OriginHeader.description: Trusted application origin used to create the sign-in link.

UserIdPath.name: id
UserIdPath.description: Authenticated user's account identifier. Must match the current account.

AccountContextNotFound.description: The account, session, or congregation context no longer exists.

AuthenticatedRequestForbidden.description: Authentication or ownership checks rejected the request.

AuthenticationResult.description: Authentication succeeded or requires MFA verification.

Set-Cookie.description: Sets the signed visitor session cookie.

AuthenticationNotFound.description: The identity token is invalid or the account does not exist.

BadRequest.description: Request headers, parameters, or payload failed validation.

BackupBadRequest.description: Backup metadata, payload, or chunk validation failed, or the backup is outdated.

BackupConflict.description: The metadata is outdated or another backup upload is active.

CongregationAccessForbidden.description: The active account is not a member or lacks the required congregation role.

CongregationCreationRejected.description: The congregation could not be validated or already exists.

DirectoryFetchFailed.description: The external congregation directory request failed.

InternalError.description: The request could not be completed because of an internal failure.

InvalidAuthenticationToken.description: The one-time password is invalid or expired.

MfaRequired.description: The active session must complete MFA verification.

MeetingResourceNotFound.description: The congregation or visiting-speaker access request does not exist.

OriginNotAllowed.description: The browser origin is not trusted.

PocketBackupBadRequest.description: Pocket backup metadata is invalid or older than the server state.

PocketInvitationRejected.description: The invitation code is missing, malformed, expired, or no longer assigned.

PocketResourceNotFound.description: The Pocket account, congregation, or requested session does not exist.

PocketSessionForbidden.description: The Pocket cookie is missing, revoked, or is not authorized for the congregation.

AdministrationResult.description: The global administration operation completed successfully.

AdministrationForbidden.description: The session is missing, revoked, or does not belong to a global administrator.

AdministrationResourceNotFound.description: The selected user, congregation, feature flag, or request was not found.

AdministrationCongregationActive.description: The congregation cannot be deleted while it still has members.

CongregationAdministrationResult.description: The congregation administration operation completed successfully.

CongregationAdministrationForbidden.description: The session is invalid, lacks a congregation administration role, or cannot access the selected congregation.

CongregationAdministrationNotFound.description: The congregation, member account, or join request was not found.

TooManyRequests.description: The request rate limit was exceeded.

UserWorkflowBadRequest.description: The request is invalid, the user has no congregation, or is already a member.

UserWorkflowForbidden.description: Authentication failed or the account has no valid congregation context.

AdministrationResult.description: The current administration projection returned by the operation.

CongregationAdministrationResult.description: A refreshed congregation member or request projection, or a stable success message.

AuxiliaryApplication.description: Stored auxiliary application. Additional legacy fields may be present.

AuxiliaryApplicationSubmission.description: Application fields supplied by the client. Identity and timestamps are owned by the server.

BackupData.description: Version 3 synchronization payload. Dataset presence depends on metadata changes and account roles.

CongregationUpdates.description: Role-specific updates; fields not available to the current user are omitted.

cong_settings.description: The complete version 3 congregation settings record.

FieldServiceReport.description: Field-service report record accepted by the existing version 3 contract.

code.description: Development-only MFA code; omitted in production.

qrCode.description: An otpauth provisioning URI suitable for a QR code.

message.description: Present when a new Pocket session is created.

user_settings.description: Pocket user profile and congregation roles.

cong_settings.description: Pocket-safe congregation settings without the congregation master key.

cong_master_key.description: Returned only for roles allowed to use the congregation master key.

cong_settings.description: Congregation settings available to the authenticated member.
